description: Force every request through the Worker (middleware.ts) instead of Cloudflare's default static-asset-first serving. Without this, HTTPS-upgrade/www-stripping/legacy-redirect logic in middleware.ts silently never runs for any prerendered page's own exact URL — see the run_worker_first change in wrangler.jsonc, which this backs up in case the installed Wrangler version doesn't honor that field.
